drhp.business: Bayer CropScience Limited operates across three core business areas: Crop Protection (chemical and biological solutions for weeds, pests, and diseases), Seeds (high-performing hybrid corn seeds), and Digital Farming (precision agriculture tools and advisory platforms). The company serves Indian farmers by offering a portfolio of products and services aimed at improving yields, resilience, and resource efficiency. It leverages innovation, stewardship programs, and partnerships to support smallholder farmers and promote sustainable agricultural practices.
drhp.end_markets: Indian agriculture sector|Smallholder farmers|Corn growers|Rice growers|Wheat growers|Sugarcane growers|Vegetable growers
drhp.expansion: The Company's expansion narrative is primarily focused on scaling regenerative agriculture practices and digital farming initiatives rather than traditional brick-and-mortar capacity additions. The DirectAcres program promotes Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) across more than 100 clusters in India, currently engaging over 15,000 farmers across more than 48,000 hectares. Bayer aims to scale this initiative to support over one million smallholder farmers in adopting DSR-based cultivation systems by 2030. sk.overview: The agrochemicals (crop protection) industry covers the development, manufacture and distribution of insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators in Formulations and Technicals form. Per the issuer-commissioned ICRA Report (February 2026), the sector is supported by resilient Indian agriculture (healthy reservoir levels, robust crop production sustaining rural demand), a global 'China+1' shift favouring Indian chemical manufacturing, and sustained government fiscal support to agriculture and manufacturing.
